Settings

Customize the prototype, back up data and reset examples after changing seed files.

Facility & Appearance

Data Backup & Restore

Export all browser data as JSON. You can import that file on another browser or computer to continue the demonstration.

Reset Demo Data

If you edit technician names or sample equipment in js/seed.js, the browser may still display your older saved copy. Resetting will load your updated example data and erase all changes saved in this browser.

Important: This is a frontend-only prototype. LocalStorage is device/browser-specific, not secure, and not suitable for real multi-user production use. GitHub Pages can host the frontend, but does not supply authentication, a shared database, or server-side audit logs.
